introduction.title: Send DuckDB activity to an event handler
paragraphs: Events exposes query, transaction, and connection activity from a DuckDB process. It starts a handler program and writes structured JSON events to that program’s standard input.

Use the stream to build a query log, track failures, or feed an existing monitoring system. You choose which events to capture and what the handler does with them. The extension provides the events; storing them and sending alerts are responsibilities of the handler.
